title: C03 request not covered
description: What a query for a request id returns when the owner does not hold it and its state was restored from a backup. The request may have been received after that backup was taken, so the owner can say neither that it never received it nor what it did: the record names the id and, as `restore_digest`, the restore report of the owner's latest restore, whose covered frontier bounds what the owner holds — and nothing else. On its strength nothing may treat the request as absent, failed or safe to start again under a new id.
